maya: Quick sync — I brought up the q4-hs (handshake-quant) variant on titan-ops for a quick smoke. Observed ~1.9x throughput vs fp16 for seq=512,batch=8.

ravi: Nice — numbers on p50/p95/p99?

maya: p50 ~ 18ms (was 33ms fp16), p95 ~ 46ms (was 78ms), p99 ~ 82ms (was 160ms). throughput measured with bench job below. Quality check: dev-qa set (2k samples) shows Rouge-L drop ~0.8 points and hallucination rate up from 0.6% -> 1.8%.

ravi: Can you paste the bench command + config we used?

maya: ```
# bench command
./bench --model q4-hs --seq 512 --batch 8 --spec-handshake=true --warmup 1000

# perf summary
throughput: 1.92x vs fp16
p50: 18ms
p95: 46ms
p99: 82ms
```

zane: Important question — how were the eval runs sampled? sampling params, temp/decoding, seeds? Also did we use the handshake-suspect verifier (fp16) in the loop or is this pure q4 output?

maya: Eval details: 2,000 prompts sampled stratified across short (<=64), mid (65-256), long (257-1024). Decoding = top-k sampling (k=40), temp=0.7, 3 seeds per prompt (seed variance averaged). This run was pure q4-hs output (no realtime verification). The handshake mode currently does token-prefix speculative prefetching (spec model proposes tokens while verifier runs in background) but here we flipped verifier-off to get raw quality signal.

zane: Ah — so some of the hallucination could be from quantization + speculative prefill mismatch. We should try the handshake with verifier-on and re-rank top candidates to measure regression mitigation.

evalbot: CI-run 9587654321-1 completed: 
- Rouge-L mean before (fp16 baseline): 34.2
- Rouge-L mean q4-hs (no verifier): 33.4
- Hallucination rate baseline: 0.6% -> q4-hs: 1.8%
- Sample size: 2k prompts, 3 seeds each
(artifact: s3://redwood-evals/9587654321/q4-hs/)

ravi: Given perf win + quality delta, propose rollout plan: canary at 5-10% with verifier-on for safety, instrument token-disagreement ratio as alert, and automatic fallback to fp16 when disagreement > X for > Y seconds. Thoughts? :mechanical_arm:

maya: +1. Also recommend synthetic stress on long-form prompts (>=512) and targeted cases from our hallucination corpus. I'll run handshake-with-verifier-on ablation and post results.

zane: Also run quant rounding noise ablation: quantize with three different calibrations (minmax, percentile(99.9), range-scaling) and compare top-k logits drift. Check seed sensitivity too.

maya: Plan:
1) Run handshake-with-verifier-on (2k prompts) by EOD with same seeds and produce per-token disagreement ratio + rerank lift.
2) Run 3x calibration ablations (1k prompts each) and collect logit drift histograms.
3) Canary plan doc for infra (ravi) + rollback rule.

ravi: I'll wire a canary deploy window (eng-dedicated) and add alert for hallucination-rate increase > 0.5pp over baseline for > 15m, and token-disagreement rate > 2% for > 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: cluster=eng-dedicated, window=03:00-05:00 UTC, traffic=10% (can be paused).

maya: Thanks — will post the handshake+verifier runs and raw artifacts once finished. If verifier brings hallucination back in line, we can evaluate cost delta for verifier overhead vs net fallback benefit.

zane: Good. One more ask: capture per-prompt meta (length, domain, anchor tokens) so we can stratify regressions.

maya: On it. Will tag artifacts with prompt strata and seed.

ravi: Sounds good — thumbs up to canary after we have verifier-on numbers. :thumbsup:

maya: Quick TODOs tracked here: s3://redwood-evals/9587654321/notes.md — will update with results.

evalbot: Reminder: retention policy — keep artifacts for 30 days by default.

zane: Thanks all, will review the ablation outputs when uploaded.
